notes.title: [NJPW Collaboration DLC: Plans to Make Available Offline]
notes.content:
Let me start by saying: [b]We plan to make the DLC usable in offline mode[/b].

As many users have pointed out, the NJPW DLC currently requires an online connection to use. 
The console DLC requires an Internet connection for verification checks, so this design was carried over to the Steam version.

Now that we have a handle on the situation and a clear plan on how to resolve it, we can announce that we are working to change the ownership checks so that you can use the DLC without an Internet connection.
However, changing the ownership checks may impact game data in unexpected ways. We need time to look into the code, debug the changes and make sure there are no issues.

We will make an announcement once we are certain of the update date.
For now, please know that we plan to make the DLC usable in offline mode. 
We can’t apologize enough for the inconvenience and misunderstanding. 

Aside from the team working on the DLC, other members are also working on bugs/quality of life issues users have reported.
These patches will roll out simultaneously on all platforms. 

Some of these issues include:
[list][*]Slowdown caused by the Ver.2.000 UI update.
[*]Improvements to Workshop usability.
[*]Issue where wrestler theme does not play post-match.
[*]Issue where deleting a team can cause existing stables to move to a different promotion.
[*]Reducing lag in online matches.
[*]Improving load times.[/list]

We are aware of many of the current issues, but if you have a particular request, please let us know in the comments.

-Dave K
Steam Community Manager

[list][*]Multiple wrestlers may now enter ring together.
*Adjust settings from: [Settings] > [Entrance Style]
[*]You can now move human controlled wrestlers during entrances.

[*]Can now right click to delete a layer.
[*]Copy/Paste remapped from Backspace to F1.
[*]Can now copy/paste colors with Ctrl+C/Ctrl+V.
[*]Can now delete layers with Delete key.
[*]Fixed bug where cursor would disappear if you double clicked the Part Preview button.
[*]Parts Preview now properly rotates when you click the arrow buttons.
[*]If you click outside the color wheel, the color wheel menu will close.

[*]Can now close copy/paste menu. [Xbox: Y button / PS4: Triangle button / Keyboard: F1, right click][/list]

[*]CPU wrestlers now perform a taunt after winning a match.
*This taunt will be the move set to [Performance 4].
[*]Referee now stops counting a ring out sooner.
[*]Exploit fixed that allowed a wrestler to connect with too many post moves before opponent recovered.
[*]Fixed bug where CPU Level wasn’t properly taken into consideration when reversing moves in a CPU vs CPU match. 
*Wrestler taking the move was at a disadvantage.
[*]Fixed bug where wrestler would slump against post in deathmatches with fluorescent tubes/barbed wire boards against post.[/list]
[b][VENUES][/b]
[list][*]Adjusted look of ring colors.[/list]
Added the following venues:
[list][*]SCS Stadium
[*]Arena de Universo
[*]Spike Dome[/list]

Added the following moves:

[*]Counter [High Angle Drop Kick]
[*]Front Grapple (BIG) [Phoenixplex Hold]
[/list]
[list][*]Adjusted: Standing [High Angle Drop Kick]
[*]Adjusted: Opponent Down - Face Down, Near Head [Omoplata Crossface]

notes.content:
Version 0.9008 was published today.
Please refer to the patch notes below.
We have been watching the forums and are working to address the issues reported.
We thank you for your patience and understanding as we continue to make improvements through Early Access.

Please post patch-related comments to
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/564230/discussions/2/3223871682611800384/]this thread[/url] so that we may better track your feedback.

[b]Offline Mode[/b]
[list][*]Fixed bug where incorrect move name would display on match results screen when match was won with Okite Yaburi.
[*]Wrestler Select Screen: You can now move the cursor without waiting for the wrestlers to load.
[*]Exhibition Match: Fixed bug where you could use the mouse to select wrestlers that were otherwise unselectable.
[*]Wrestler Select Screen: Fixed bug where, when selecting a wrestler with the mouse after scrolling the menu, the wrong wrestler would be selected.
[*]Timed Battle Royal: Entrance Settings > Time settings now saves even when you move between menus.
[*]Mission Mode: With the cursor over the [Return] button, pressing up/down now returns you to the Mission List menu.
[*]Mission Mode: Made text boxes easier to read.
[*]While playing in Windowed Mode, fixed the mouse so it will only respond when the application is the active window.
[*]Added [Cache] option.
 This caches the Wrestler Select menu graphics for your entire collection of wrestlers and speeds up the Wrestler Select menu.
 To create a cache, turn the option ON and restart the application. 
*Each wrestler requires around 20MB of memory so please make sure you have enough available disk space. [/list]

[b]Edit Mode[/b]
[list][*]Fixed bug where full wrestler name would not display properly.
[*]Can now press LB(L1)/RB(R1) to rotate the item in the Part Preview window.
[*]Added full body preview button in place of the pull-down menu.
[*]Changed the Highlights button size/text.
[*]Can now toggle through highlight settings in place of the pull-down menu.
[*]Changed base color of parts displayed in the Layer list.
[*]Part selection cursor set to hidden when using Filter window.
[*]Moveset Edit: Fixed moves that were not displaying properly.
[*][Back Grapple](MED) Back Tackle > Changed category from “Rough” to “Position Change.” 
[*]Skill Menu: Can now use left/right buttons to move between screens.
[*]When selecting an edit wrestler/referee to load, it now displays their full profile instead of a thumbnail.
[*]CPU Logic Menu: Fixed bug that would move the cursor back to the left-hand window if you pressed cancel while entering a percentage.
[*]Fixed bug that prevented you from saving an edit wrestler if you had too many wrestlers assigned to “Retire.” 
[*]Increased font size of wrestler name.
[*]Changed position of Nickname window.
[*]Belt Edit: Fixed bug that hid belt information behind the belt preview when saving.
[*]Team Edit: On the wrestler select screen, organizations without any assigned wrestlers will be moved to the end of the rotation. 
[*]Team Edit: Fixed bug where if you reorder a wrestler, then cancel before confirming, the wrestler would be moved regardless.[/list]

[b]Online Mode[/b]
[list][*]Changed graphics for pull-down menu/chat window.[/list]

[b]Matches[/b]
[list][*]Adjusted time that a wrestler stays down after being hit by a [Jump from Post] move.
[*]CPU logic: [Jump from Post > Lrg Dmg] moves were not occurring as frequently as intended so parameters have been adjusted so these moves are used more often.
[*]Adjusted timing for [Run up Turnbuckle] moves
[*]Fixed bug where wrestlers would swap position with certain return moves (such as Lightning Speed).[/list]

[b]Wrestler Data[/b]
[list][*]Fixed CPU logic bug for default wrestler Caroline Collins where [Opp Down – Face down] > [Opp. Condition Critical] was set to over 100%[/list] 

[b]Moves[/b]
[list][*]Added [Running > Turning Arm Breaker B]
[*]Added [Front Grapple (BIG) > Backflip Driver
[*]Added [Front Avalanche Setup Counter > Top Rope Canadian Destroyer][/list]

[b]Edit Parts[/b]
[list][*]Added Face 688-697, Part 688-697.[/list]

notes.content:
Version 0.9007 was published today.
Please refer to the patch notes below.
We have been watching the forums and are working to address the issues reported.
We thank you for your patience and understanding as we continue to make improvements through Early Access.

Please post patch-related comments to
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/564230/discussions/2/1473095965306528798/]this thread[/url] so that we may better track your feedback.

[b]CUSTOM MUSIC[/b]
[list][*]Fixed freeze bug on Skill menu.[/list]

[b]OFFLINE MODE[/b]
[list][*]Failsafe added at launch to check that the save data and application version are compatible . If the application version is older than the save data, you will receive a warning and the game will not launch.
[*]A notification now appears if your save data is updated at launch time.
[*]Exhibition Match: Fixed bug that would reset a wrestler’s costume when their position was reshuffled on the Wrestler Select screen.
[*]Fixed bug that caused a 10-count if you played a Battle Royal after a SWA Rules Match.
[*]Exhibition Match/Battle Royal: Font now scales down for wrestler names using 12 or more characters. 
[*]Tournament/League: When selecting Stables and Organizations, wrestlers are no longer displayed in the active left window.
[*]Tournament/League: [Keyboard controls] When selecting Organizations, pressing the Up key now properly displays wrestlers in the active left window.
[*]Tournament/League: [Keyboard controls] Fixed bug that would prevent arrow keys from working if the mouse cursor was over a button.
[/list]

[b]EDIT MODE[/b]
[list][*]Wrestler Appearance Menu: Fixed bug where highlight settings would not copy when copying body part layers.
[/list]

[b]MATCHES[/b]
[list][*]Battle Royal: CPU no longer tries to attack a defeated opponent leaving the ring.
[*]Battle Royal: If a CPU wrestler has no current opponent, they will walk forward in the current direction (and will no longer 3D walk).
[*]A defeated wrestler will no longer stand up themselves.
*This includes the final wrestler defeated in a Battle Royal.
[*]A defeated wrestler will no longer reverse moves.
[*]If a wrestler is Irish Whipped into the corner post at an angle, they will now slump against the post.
[*]Fixed bug preventing fluorescent tubes from appearing as random weapons.
[*]Adjusted damage from colliding with walls/barbed wire/fluorescent tubes, as well as from landmines.
*Increased damage for explosive gimmicks.
[*]Cage Deathmatch: CPU will no longer attempt pinfalls with Win Condition set to Give Up Only/Escape.
*Specifically this disables the pinfall button. Other pinfall moves may be used.
*Priority Moves set to the pinfall button will be ignored.

notes.title: DEV BLOG #6: CUSTOM MUSIC SUPPORT & S-1 RULES
notes.content:
Hello Fire Pro fans, company mouthpiece Dave K here with an update on our progress through Early Access.

Since launch we’ve focused on bug fixes with weekly patches, but we’re ready to shift our attention to expanding your gameplay options.

Our latest patch rolls out two new features: Custom music support and S-1 rules!

Custom music support allows you to set your own wrestler entrance theme and match BGM. This feature supports MP3, WAV and OGG file types.

First things first: To get the music into your game, move the files into the game’s installation directory. By default, this should be something like:
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\FPW\BGM
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28002792/2afb3b90460ad47aa241778d41a1cfd0dc4c7275.png[/img]
You can set a wrestler’s entrance theme from:
Edit Mode > Wrestler Edit (Create/load your wrestler) Skill > Theme Music > Skill > Entrance Theme

And to set music during a match, set up a match as normal, then go to:
Settings > Match BGM

Also, this is very important: DO NOT add/remove music files while the game is running! This may cause unexpected issues. Please exit the game before sorting your music collection.

The Workshop doesn’t support custom music, so if you upload a wrestler with custom music to the Workshop, the theme of the Workshop wrestler will revert to the default track.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28002792/0c6503eb745432ce72e119b1f833a939ac19c44d.jpg[/img]
The other new feature should be familiar to longtime fans: S-1 Rules Match (the Fire Pro answer to kickboxing)! Originally we didn’t plan to include this mode, but enough people asked for it so it’s back by popular demand.

Before you trade your tights for boxer shorts, keep the following S-1 special rules in mind:
[list][*]Matches are decided by KO/TKO
[*]Matches are fought in timed rounds (similar to Gruesome Fighting)
[*]No grappling moves/submissions
[*]No running inside the ring
[*]Strikes receive a large damage bonus for wrestlers using an MMA-centric fight style (Shooter, Grappler, Fighter)

That about covers the new features. For detailed patch notes, please visit the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/564230/discussions/2/2183537632739413100/]Steam forums[/url].

One last thing before I sign off:

We launched a [url=https://www.twitch.tv/spike_chunsoft]Twitch channel[/url] to directly address user feedback and announce upcoming features.

Even I don’t know what Director Matsumoto will let slip until we’re on the air, so be sure to drop by!

In a few weeks we’ll have the head programmer on as a guest to talk shop and show us how the engine works under the hood. Watch this space for details, or follow us on Twitter, Facebook and Steam!

Until next time, stay strong.
-Dave K

[*]With the parts list menu open, pressing LB/RB(Xbox)/L1/R1(PS4) cycles through pages of parts.

[*]Revised filter font size and order.
[*]Multiple filters may be applied simultaneously.

[list][*]Fixed bug where Ukemi was not providing a spirit and attack boost.[/list]

[list][*]Revised issue where Calf > Bear parts were darker than bear parts for the rest of the body.[/list]

[list][*]Counter: Flapjack

>If your edit is missing a thumbnail, sometimes it will fail to update the thumbnail. In this case, please proceed to Step 2:

notes.title: Early Access Features - New Info Detailed
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28002792/a737a71069e77fccb380ea629c5e19fa0569670c.png[/img]
Greetings grapple fans! This is Dave K, the Spike Chunsoft Community Manager.
Japanese gaming magazine Famitsu recently revealed a slew of new details so I’m compiling the info here for the rest of the world.
So what’s on the docket? First up: Confirmed game modes!

[b][OFFLINE PLAY][/b]
[b]Exhibition:[/b] Single match with specific rules. (More on that below)
[b]Tournament:[/b] Single-elimination tournament with up to 32 wrestlers. 
[b]League:[/b] 8 wrestlers per bracket with up to 4 brackets. 

RULES:
[b]Normal Match:[/b] Standard match with no special rules.
[b]Cage Deathmatch:[/b] The ring is surrounded by a steel cage. The first to climb over the top and escape (or pin the opponent) wins.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28002792/d3128f5aa01b06d1fd7f2b1b43aeccd8bf428300.jpg[/img]
[b]Barbed Wire Deathmatch:[/b] The ring is enclosed in electrified barbed wire that explodes on impact, causing huge damage and possibly bleeding.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28002792/27801c2511e1eaa2e232761bf51856ef5ebd7b09.jpg[/img]
[b]Landmine Deathmatch:[/b] Landmines are set around the ring. If someone is thrown outside the ring, the landmines explode for massive damage. You can also set the landmines to go off at a fixed time.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28002792/50c70677403ca836b492ffc2e3be0b9f7bab490c.jpg[/img]
[b]SWA Rules Match:[/b] Our own homebrew rules (SWA=Spike Wrestling Association) that are a mix of pro wrestling and MMA. No fighting outside the ring, no pinfalls: Matches are determined by a ten-count or KO.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28002792/cd0ea6465ad36c0ad368fa23913a368247b7ecbc.png[/img]
[b]Gruesome Fighting:[/b] 3-minute rounds fought in a 12-sided ring built for MMA matches.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28002792/def41cd56ece37330725403c4bb2526e3fdd4da5.jpg[/img]
[b]Participants:[/b] Single, tag, 6-man tag, 8-man tag, mixed.
[b]Battle Royal[/b][list]     [*]Normal: Eliminated wrestlers are forced to leave the ring.
    [*]First Win: First pinfall wins the match.
    [*]Endless: Eliminated wrestlers stay in the ring and continue to fight.
    [*]Over-Rope: Any participant that is thrown over the rope is eliminated.
    [*]Timed: The match starts with two wrestlers and other participants enter at timed intervals. [/list] 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28002792/de0ab506b1249be4f99d815daeb6ef2eda83f1b3.jpg[/img]
[b]Title Match:[/b] A mode to decide which wrestler is worthy to earn your custom title belt. 
[b]Mission Mode:[/b] Single-player mode that teaches you the ropes. Geared towards new players who need to learn the grappling system and controls. 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28002792/5ab0b58d7a54f03bd4fd756c1dce468be83a44ee.jpg[/img]
And while not technically a "mode," you can set all participants to CPU for simulated matches between computer-controlled wrestlers. Wrestling [i]is[/i] the king of spectator sports, after all.

[b][ONLINE PLAY][/b]
Everything listed above. Only single matches (1v1) will be initially supported. We hope to increase the player count in the future. 

[b]Edit Mode:[/b] Create custom wrestlers, referees, teams, rings and championship belts! Workshop support makes it easy to share your creations. (More info about the Workshop in a future post, I promise.)
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28002792/39ee67904c8ce6a2281996f6087aa36d019827a7.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28002792/ee69f2520c26b3bf390b1730f965f99428a5058e.jpg[/img]

[b][NEW FEATURES][/b] 
[b]Overhauled Edit Mode:[/b] Now each body part supports up to 9 texture layers for deeper customization. In a future post, I’ll explain how we made the interface more user-friendly.
[b]Move Rename:[/b] Since you can customize every other facet of your wrestler, it’s only appropriate that you can now also rename their signature moves. 
[b]Exchange Blows:[/b] That classic back-and-forth contest of fighting spirit where wrestlers take turns trading hits until one (or both) of them falls. 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28002792/f271efe81956f365e7efd1732fff3c3eb154f3cf.gif[/img]
[b]Okite Yaburi:[/b] Japanese wrestling term that implies a blatant diregard for the law. In the west we’d say “Move steal.” Once per match, you’re allowed to use your opponent’s finishing move against them in the ultimate sign of disrespect. 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28002792/12ffb6f8ea8881b5435b17ee863b306498c75593.jpg[/img]
Run Into Ring: Now you can run and slide into the ring to keep the action flowing. 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28002792/88aec3ff2a90fcf3e098c0ca28dd9c23b920aa29.gif[/img]
[b]Rope Escape:[/b] When you’re in a submission hold, hold R1 to inch towards the rope in hopes of a rope break. 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28002792/c56b13473dacf62eb1b45a82d6cdb6fbc1be8016.gif[/img]

[b][NEW MOVES][/b]
In the ten years since the previous [i]Fire Pro was released[/i], the sport has developed a plethora of exciting new moves. [i]Fire Pro Wrestling World[/i] means to make up for lost time! Here’s a sampling of the many techniques we plan to add:  
[list][*]Twisting Pull Down Face Buster
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28002792/8a3d4deb06e45bacc050d43186f46de83ec4cbb5.gif[/img]
    [*]Pole Shift Flowsion
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28002792/6e69242ca7744ad02b7c6424e19a8a02a7b3265f.gif[/img]
    [*]Turning Short Range Lariat
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28002792/50a0bce7cd5b78ed0ae75652e21ec44fde216b08.gif[/img]
[/list] 
That's about everything that's been confirmed! (At the moment, mind you.)
What would you be interested in seeing next? Let me know in the comments and I'll pass it along to the devs and director.

-Dave K
